title: OL-20261113-7: WORKERS-1 repo inventory and server-side code-agent loop on workers
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** daily
**Done check:** file:docs/ROADMAP.md
**Status:** closed

Survey ultrastable/workers vs ultrastable, archive redundant repos with disposition, run the code-agent loop server-side on workers.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 196.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
